summary: Live security smoke testing completed: registration/login/me, nurse profile isolation, admin self-promotion rejection, public jobs, frontend boot.

critical.issue: PATCH and GET dispatch do not validate resource against the allowlist; an authenticated user can potentially address arbitrary Mongo collections (PATCH is especially unsafe). DELETE is constrained, but PATCH lacks the same guard.

minor.issue: Returns 401 (and no unauthenticated status response), contrary to expected existing API reachability.

integration_issues.issue: UI is only the starter Emergent shell; no NurseConnect auth, dashboards, jobs, applications, interviews, or document workflows are implemented.

action_items: Validate resource allowlists in GET/PATCH handlers before collection access.
Implement NurseConnect frontend auth and protected workflows or explicitly scope this checkout as backend-only.
Restore/define unauthenticated /api/status if health reachability is required.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH handler constructs db[resource + 's'] without checking resource allowlist, unlike create/list.
current_user catches Exception broadly, obscuring database failures as 401.
No real admin account was available, so admin-positive access was not verified.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ nurse accounts/profile for live testing; no demo/seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL loaded. One pytest passed for auth/isolation. Frontend remains starter shell. Test credentials file is empty; no admin-positive test performed.
rca of the issue: The route handlers are generic and only list/create enforce PRIVATE/resource membership. GET/PATCH fall through to collection_name/resource + 's', allowing arbitrary collection targeting by authenticated users. Add a shared resource validation dependency/guard at the start of read/update (and ideally all generic handlers).
